recommendation: Reimplement PR #1 as a clean review branch or stacked PR series. Do not ask a human reviewer to review the current chronological/fixup-heavy history.
review_strategy: Keep every commit buildable/testable where realistic.
Separate mechanical refactors from behavior changes.
Put tests near the feature they validate instead of leaving all tests to the end.
Keep GHCR publishing separate from runtime behavior.
Keep AI/Codex/planning files out of the main functional MR unless they are explicitly wanted.
Do not change default image source silently; expose GHCR through documented flags or a clearly justified commit.

things_i_would_change_from_the_current_m: Do not keep chronological commits like Update, Fix, Try fix it, Another day another coinjoin fix. Rebase into semantic commits.
Do not mix GHCR publishing, JoinMarket behavior, Wasabi Dockerfile changes, and Kubernetes refactors in one giant commit.
Do not make ghcr.io/ondrejman the default image prefix unless the MR title/body explicitly says this is a behavior change.
Do not switch final Wasabi runtime stages to SDK images unless there is a concrete runtime dependency that requires the SDK.
Keep .codex skills and TODO files optional; they are not necessary for the emulator functionality.
Remove newCommits.md from the final reviewed branch.
Keep tests close to the feature commits, or at least make sure each phase has its own tests before moving to the next phase.
